description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team. 
 
 
 Role overview 
 We’re looking for a .Net Software Engineer to help design, build, and support our core platform. 
 
 In this role, you’ll contribute to backend services, APIs, data access, integrations, and some UI components in a cloud-based, event-driven architecture. Our technology stack includes C#, .NET, PostgreSQL, AWS, Blazor, and MudBlazor, with services running across Lambda, ECS, and EC2. 
 
 We build distributed systems that communicate through APIs and events, and we continue to improve our engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities. 
 
 We take an AI-first approach to software development, using approved AI tools to support design, coding, testing, refactoring, documentation, and problem-solving. You’ll be encouraged to use these tools thoughtfully and responsibly as part of your day-to-day work. 
 
 This role suits someone who enjoys hands-on development, collaborative problem-solving, and delivering reliable software in a practical, iterative environment. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain secure, reliable, and maintainable software 

 Develop and support .NET services and APIs within an event-driven microservices architecture 

 Contribute to integrations between systems using APIs and events 

 Work with PostgreSQL and data access patterns to deliver scalable, supportable solutions 

 Support applications and services hosted in AWS, including Lambda, ECS, and EC2 

 Contribute to UI development in Blazor and MudBlazor where needed 

 Break down requirements and solution designs into clear technical tasks 

 Participate in estimation, planning, and technical discussions 

 Take part in peer reviews and contribute to shared coding standards and quality practices 

 Write automated tests and help improve software quality and reliability 

 Troubleshoot defects, investigate incidents, and support production issues when needed 

 Create and maintain clear technical documentation 

 Use approved AI-assisted development tools responsibly and in line with engineering, security, and quality standards 

 
 Requirements 
 Minimum 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer building production application in C# and .NET 

 Experience building and maintaining backend services and APIs

 Experience working with event-driven systems , asynchronous messaging patterns, or service-based architectures

 Understanding of RESTful APIs and service-to-service communication

 Experience with relational databases , preferably PostgreSQL 

 Understanding of automated tests and good software quality practices

 Experience using source control and collaborating through code review practices

 Ability to work from technical documentation and break development work into clear technical tasks

 Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of day-to-day engineering work

 Good written and verbal communication skills

 Comfortable working in a pragmatic delivery environment that draws from agile principles without following a strict framework

 
 Nice to have: 
 Experience with microservices architecture 

 Experience with BFF patterns 

 Experience with AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, EC2 , or related cloud-hosted environments

 Experience with PostgreSQL in production systems

 Experience with Blazor and/or MudBlazor 

 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes

 Familiarity with Docker or container-based development

 Exposure to observability, logging, and monitoring practices in distributed systems

 Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot 

 Awareness of secure coding practices and building resilient applications

 
 #LI-Hybrid 
 #LI-LM1 

 
 We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective. 
 
 Use of AI in Hiring  
 As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
